note: 24 Nov, the owner: "80% Bobert. 70% Riker. 60% Bill", "follow the naming convention", "use a new rental if needed". Same as cut-bobert-flashnext (Unsloth Q8_0, REAP keep list from reap-flashnext-q4-jobs, read from the normal Nov 21 runs, never held-out) at 60% kept (Bill, 308 of 512 experts per layer, all-keep-60.json) and 70% kept (Riker, 359 per layer, all-keep-70.json), names "Bill {N}Bob A6B Flash-Next REAP60" and "Riker {N}Bob A6B Flash-Next REAP70", ONE pod, Bill first then Riker. Its own imatrix (training chats only; Bobert's imatrix is for other experts). IQ2s put the 640-wide down experts at q2_0. Each quant must pass the publish gate (size within 10% of the prediction, loads, two sensible answers) before it goes up, PRIVATE until the owner says public. Then it serves the IQ2_XXS for Bob's HELD-OUT jobs. Nothing is healed. Not an H200-class card (the account allows one at a time and Bobert holds it).
